description: Machine-readable scientific contract generated from paper/protocol claims, BEFORE paired execution traces are evaluated. Contracts are the predicates checked against a runtime trace. No fault-specific rules are added after observing negative executions.
design_principles: Generated from paper text only. The specific values (seed count, split names, subgroup labels) must come from the paper, not from ontology defaults.
Each contract predicate references concrete trace fields from TRACE_SCHEMA.json so the verifier can evaluate SATISFIED / VIOLATED / UNOBSERVABLE.
Coverage-based PASS: a sample passes only if all material observable requirements are satisfied AND evidence coverage >= pre-registered threshold. Absence of evidence is ABSTAIN, never PASS.

paper_text_hash.description: SHA256 of the extracted paper text the contract was derived from. Provenance anchor.

source_span.description: Verbatim paper text span(s) from which the requirements were induced.

predicates.description: Machine-checkable scientific requirements. Each maps to a trace field.

principle.description: Universal principle that motivates this predicate. The concrete VALUE comes from the paper.

trace_fields.description: Dot-paths into TRACE_SCHEMA root object, e.g. ['protocol', 'selection_split'], ['checkpoint', 'selected'].

condition.description: A boolean expression over trace fields. E.g. 'protocol.selection_split != final_test_split'.

source_span.description: Paper text that justifies this specific condition (provenance, not 'global').

universal_principles.description: IDs of P1-P8 abstract principles applied (motivate predicate types, do not supply paper-specific values).

coverage_threshold.description: Pre-registered minimum fraction of material requirements that must be SATISFIED (and observable) for a PASS. Frozen before any trace is evaluated.

example_predicates.note: E01 SEED_SELECTION_BIAS — paper declares mean over 5 seeds; invalid execution aggregates the best seed.

example_predicates.natural_language: Reported value must equal the declared aggregation over the declared seed population.
example_predicates.source_span: We report the mean accuracy across five random seeds.

example_predicates.note: E02 TEST_CONDITIONED_CHECKPOINT_SELECTION — paper says test split only for final eval.

example_predicates.natural_language: Checkpoint selection must not use the final test split.
example_predicates.source_span: The test set is used exclusively for final evaluation.

example_predicates.note: E04 SUBGROUP_SELECTIVE_REPORTING — paper declares all subgroups reported; execution reports a biased subset.

example_predicates.natural_language: All declared subgroups must appear in the reported outputs.
example_predicates.source_span: We report per-subgroup accuracy for all four demographic groups.

verdict_rules.FAIL: At least one material predicate is confirmed VIOLATED (condition evaluates false on observed trace fields).
verdict_rules.PASS: All material observable predicates SATISFIED and coverage >= coverage_threshold.
verdict_rules.ABSTAIN: No confirmed violation, but coverage < threshold, or a required trace field is missing/UNOBSERVABLE.

localization_requirement: Every FAIL must emit a trace witness: the violated predicate_id, the trace entities involved, the dependency path, and the reported output affected. A generic FAIL with no witness is rejected.
